title: Desktop control and ownership contract
scope: Headless, off-by-default versioned capability schema. No live product wiring (that is the feature stories G010+); no physical activation (gated by G007).
domains: contract base: ControlEnvelope (u8 version|u8 domain|u16 kind|u32 generation|u32 payload_len|payload, 12B header, 256KiB cap), ControlGeneration (RFC1982 wrap-safe), DowngradeReason (forward-compatible), ControlDomain, shared TransitionStatus, single-owner OwnershipLease
privacy/display lease: PrivacyRequest, transactional PrivacyState with protection bitflags
clipboard kinds: offer bitset + single-kind request
file-transfer control: FileOffer (bounded UTF-8 name), accept, cancel(reason), progress

evidence_categories.golden_vectors: byte-pinned encode vectors identical across Rust and TS (envelope, display mode request/result, privacy state, file offer/cancel)
evidence_categories.malformed: truncation, unknown status/owner codes, reserved protection/clipboard bits, invalid UTF-8 name all rejected
evidence_categories.oversize: envelope payload over 256KiB and file name over 1024B refused on encode; oversize declared payload_len rejected on decode
evidence_categories.wrap: ControlGeneration.supersedes correct across the u32 wrap and half-range boundary
evidence_categories.reconnect: OwnershipLease.release admits a fresh (even lower) generation after a clean teardown
evidence_categories.ownership_invariant: stale generation is rejected by admit() without mutating the lease; generation-gated envelope test proves a stale Display mode-request is dropped

notes: Implemented as one dedicated contract module rather than scattered edits into common/src/config.rs / input_wire.rs / client-transport/src/cursor.rs / streamer/src/transport/cursor_wire.rs / web/stream/cursor_wire.ts (the planner's guessed surfaces). A single versioned schema module is cleaner and is the predecessor the feature stories (G010 cursor, G011 display, G015 privacy, G011/G012 clipboard/file) consume.
